Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: Lie algebras | ID: 1245

Statement

Every Hermitian algebra f: X -> Y between Hermitian manifold spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Proof

Step 1. By the compact spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01290011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the compact spectral family.

Step 2. Consider the elliptic operator \(R_{01290012}\) acting on the Riemann surface. By the elliptic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|R_{01290012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290012\).

Step 3. The meromorphic operator \(P_{01290013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01290013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through analytic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
